summary: Compile redundant QA V3 answer and arithmetic fields locally and expose a bounded validator category for saved Reference contract failures.
decision_refs: The fixed DeepSeek Flash baseline produced seven terminal contract failures across citation scope, entity scope, answer shape and arithmetic
One accepted answer already contained a locally verified result of 12 in its calculation object but omitted 12 from the displayed answer
The approved ponytail plan prioritizes the existing response contract and evidence modality gaps before any new retrieval or model-routing framework
approval_evidence: The user approved the concrete next-development plan and explicitly requested implementation, testing and iteration to continue.
known_limitations: Local compilation reduces redundant model formatting but does not prove that selected evidence is relevant or that an answer is correct.
Exact citation, entity, numeric and source-scope validators remain authoritative and can still reject unsupported content.
Historical evaluation results and failures remain immutable; the new safe category is derived from an existing settled call diagnostic when a receipt is available.
No live provider call is part of this implementation change; the fixed-15 rerun is a separate operational validation after all offline gates pass.
